headline: Frontline surges at Fishermans Row Lykos Isle Farranac Coast
war_summary: Since the 09:10 edition the western fringe has flared. Fishermans Row logged four ownership changes in the past two hours, the latest at 12:10 Z, lifting its day‑total to nineteen flips. Lykos Isle, quiet in the earlier report, now records two captures in the last two hours and twenty in the past day, the most recent at 10:25 Z. Farranac Coast and Tempest Island have added no new flips since 04:10 Z and 08:25 Z respectively, though both retain high 24‑hour counts. Godcrofts remains unchanged after a single capture at 07:25 Z. In the north Dead Lands continues its steady tempo with five events yesterday, last at 23:25 Z. Casualty streams sharpen: Weathered Expanse shows accelerating losses for both factions (≈ 970 colonial and 1 400 warden per hour), Clahstra eases but still exceeds 500 per hour each side, while Loch Mor, Linn Mercy and Marban Hollow sustain steep, rising attrition. The strategic picture still favors Colonials on the western and southern arcs and Wardens to the north and east.
